title: How U.S.-Canada Tariff Negotiations Turned Into an All-Out Trade War
summary_full: Detailed accounts of the final hours of the negotiations show that, while the United States offered Canada what it said was the best deal of any country, what Canada had to give up in exchange was seen as unthinkable.
